title: verify_sig() uses let e = |msg| SmimeError::Other(msg) idiom instead of direct inline closure
description: verify.rs line 328: let e = |msg: String| SmimeError::Other(msg); and then passes e by value to each sig_verify call. The variable e is used 6 times. This is fine but the pattern is inconsistent: cert.rs previously used |msg| SmimeError::CertChain(msg) inline without naming it. With a named closure, the move semantics are non-obvious (e is FnMut not Copy). Rewrite suggestion: inline the closure at each call site, or define it as a const fn.
